steps.content: White sand blots out the sun; dark grit dances madly in a wind, threatening to devour the sky whole. Then, a thunderous roar. A rift splits the sandstorm, and a small sand ship explodes through.
Engines screaming at full throttle, the hull shudders under the barrage of swirling sand. Sand beasts scrabble up the ship's sharp tail fins, claws latched deep into the metal.
Finally, they haul themselves onto the deck, only to spring the traps awaiting them.
Golden light flashes, severing limbs at the joint. Then, a violent lurch of the ship hurls the maimed creatures overboard. Their agonized screams trail behind as they fall.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Phew...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: That's the ninth wave since dawn. Still holding together, Miss Campbell?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I am managing. I only hope your navigation hasn't led us astray. Can we truly reach the farlands region you mentioned before nightfall?
A smile touches Rust's lips. If she still has the energy for talking back, then she's going to be alright.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: It won't take nearly that long. Come back and take a nap. By the time you wake, our destination will be in view.
Hypatia closes the comm channel. For a long moment, she stares into the distance, her silence heavy.
The brand on her neck throbs with a dull, undeniable ache—a pain rooted not in illusion, but in the brutal reality laid out before her.

WhiteSands is a different world from not long ago. Massive ashen rifts scar the landscape, their edges weeping pollutants. Sandstorms boil over the horizon in endless waves, and Corruptors stalk within them. Beneath it all, sand beasts writhe, mutating in the poisoned mud, their snarls twisting into shrieks as they turn on one another.
All of it, a cascading disaster born of the BR-005 outbreak.

A gale hurls black grit against her, peppering her skin with a thousand stinging, contaminated cuts. She doesn't flinch. She doesn't shield her eyes. She forces herself to watch, to feel, etching every detail of the devastation into her memory.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...This is your responsibility... Hypatia...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Never forget.
[Scene Change: Inside the Sand Ship]

Back inside the sand ship, Hypatia heads straight for the central purifier. The cool, sterile spray washes the last grains of contaminated grit from her skin and clothes. In the unit's damp chill, she retrieves the communicator from Margaret and places it beneath the cold vent.
Its signal has been weak and intermittent since they entered the WhiteSands, with messages arriving in frustrating, delayed bursts.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Most messages are just routine updates and words of care, but simply hearing Ms. Margaret's voice brings a sense of calm.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: She remains in Fraser, negotiating with the elites at great personal risk, fighting for justice for the farland people... I cannot fail her expectations out here.
She turns on the communicator.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ms. Margaret, it has been some time.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Two days have passed without contact. I hope all is well with you in Fraser, and that the Senate is not proving overly troublesome.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Mr. Rust and I are en route to a farland settlement known as "Crag's Nest." I understand that key leaders from various communities have gathered there for a council, to discuss the future of the farlands in this post-war era.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: We should arrive today. I promise I will not disappoint your trust. I will aid them, unite them, and help the people of the farlands overcome this hardship.
[Slowly fade to black, then pause for 2 seconds]

After her time in the cleansing room, Hypatia returns to the cabin and finds him at once: the dashing spy from DisCity, propped against the console. His focus is total, fingers dancing across screens as he navigates the ship through a fractured landscape of hazards.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: We'll enter the target zone in another two hours. Will that be sufficient for you to rest?
Hypatia shakes her head politely.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I'm fine. Don't worry about me.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Since we still have time, I will go to the engine room to check the status of the Aurum Secretum systems...
Rust raises an eyebrow.
Since their journey began, the Campbell girl has been unusually driven. Not only does she spearhead every clash with Corruptors, but she also proposes daily ship upgrades with Aurum Secretum.

Her systematic enhancements—to the engines, the fuel tanks, the wings—have already halved a five-day trek. Watching her work, Rust is convinced: with enough Aurum Secretum, she could fabricate an entire sand ship, resonance-powered and wholly new.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...The Campbells and the Luminaris Society truly found a prodigy.
He knows what drives her. Every mark on this broken land seems to sharpen her guilt, a relentless need to make amends through sheer motion.
But there have to be limits.
Rust's hand flashes out, taking the cabin keys from the dashboard before she can react. Hypatia is left clutching at nothing.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Those shadows under your eyes haven't faded much, Miss Campbell.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Haste rarely yields greatness. Take your friend Margaret, for instance... she waited in Fraser for over a decade before her current opportunity arose.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: The road ahead is still long. Use this travel time to get some proper rest. You'll need your full strength to perform when we arrive, won't you?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But...
RIIIING—
Just then, a warning light blares to life on the control panel.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Is it Mania-field contamination? I'll go!

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: No... not this time.

On the horizon, a massive black sandstorm rages toward the northwest. Its towering wall of shadow churns with clouds of Mania darker than pitch, and the sands within scream with a sound like tortured voices.
This scene of devastation is all too familiar—

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: "Tide of Ashes"... but that direction is...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: That's the pass we need to traverse to reach our destination. It seems our timing is impeccable.
Rust tosses the sand ship's safety harness to Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Hold on tight. You really don't want to be thrown from the ship.
[Black Screen, lasting more than 2 seconds]
[Scene Change: Rift Valley Encampment] [Ash Effect]
West of WhiteSands, the land dips into a valley, a final barrier between the sand sea and the sprawling farlands.
This rocky cleft has long held back the desolate dunes, its walls cupping precious moisture like a pair of sheltering hands to sustain a modest settlement.
Now, it is a breach point. Endless dark clouds, borne on the storm, have smothered the entire pass. Through the narrow gap, a tide of contamination-twisted sand beasts pours forth.
A dozen Aurum Secretum Warriors move like silver flashes between the rocks, fighting with desperate grace, but they are a dam against a flood.
Old folks and kids, fall back! Everyone who can fight, move up! Support Rael and the others! Don't let those bastards breach the line!
Grab anything that can be used as a weapon and fight! ****... Why now of all times...?
A hoarse female voice echoes off the rock walls. The woman stands on a high ledge of the camp, her face etched by the years, directing the panicked crowd below.
Inside the camp, people rush in a frenzy of pure chaos. The scars of past calamities are branded deep, triggering a primal urge to flee—though there is nowhere left to run.

Suddenly, the grinding crunch of splitting stone erupts from a nearby crevice. The leader of the valley snaps her gaze upward as a small sand ship scrapes violently through the gap between the cliffs.

It carves an ugly arc through the air, tumbles twice, and slams into the boundary marker in the center of camp. From the wreckage, a figure in black steps out with grace, followed closely by someone smaller shrouded in a WhiteSands cloak.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Hey, Yokna!

In an instant, the legendary spy's usual polish vanishes, replaced by a perfect farland accent. He slips among the locals like he'd never left, as if the suit and the swagger had all been someone else's skin.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Rust? Well, I'll be damned. Where the hell have you been hiding?

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Forget it, no time for catching up. The Apostles of Ashes have gone completely mad lately, the calamity zones keep spreading, and Fraser confiscated our Aurum Secretum for their war, knocking out our guidance systems. If you've got nothing better to do, help hold the line for a bit. I need to patch up the damn roof.
Another explosion, thunderous and deep, rocks the valley to its foundations. The walls shudder violently, raining sand and broken stone.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: That roof won't stop Apostles. Scrap the guidance idea for now. Do you still have those barrier units shipped from Furor a while back?

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Those? Just a bunch of war trophies. Good for show, useless in a fight. They're all busted, and none of our tinkerers have a clue how to fix 'em!
Rust glances at Hypatia. Her hood conceals her expression, but at the mention of Furor, her fists tighten reflexively.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Where are the Aurum Secretum barriers? I can repair them. Please, take me to them!

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: You? Who are you supposed to be?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I... I'm Mr. Rust's assistant! I can fix Aurum Secretum devices. Please, trust me!
Yokna narrows her eyes, studying the small figure beside Rust. The voice is a young girl's, but her face stays hidden beneath a WhiteSands cloak, her reasons as unclear as her features.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Hmph. Don't care who you are if you can be useful. Marco! Take the girl to the barrier units!
Hypatia's eyes light up. Without a word, she follows Yokna's subordinate toward the camp's higher ground.
Rust offers Yokna a knowing smile, a casual wave, and then turns on his heel, walking away from the settlement without looking back.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Think I'll go lend a hand out there.
